items.title: De De Pierce Interview, 1960-01-10
items.q: That's Naliska. That's Naliska. She don't play anymore. Give it up. California, so where I know.

ctx.x: Well they were years back, yeah. You know some girl troupe. Then when she sent her sister to horn, her sister learned enough to play to join Sweetheart's Rhythm. That was a colored girl band we had here too. They done well and they broke up years back too. The sister learned to dance from her. That's Naliska. That's Naliska. She don't play anymore. Give it up. California, so where I know. They had Sweetheart's Rhythm. It was a known band here at one time. You know, colored man. Girl band. One time.
Were they mostly girls from here?
